
# wow64win.dll runs the win32k system calls of 32-bit programs (user32, gdi32
# and imm32 of SysWOW64) on 64-bit ReactOS. win32k_thunks.c is generated by
# gen_win32k_thunks.py; wow64win.c has the calls written by hand.

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/win32ss/include
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/subsys)

spec2def(wow64win.dll wow64win.spec)

list(APPEND SOURCE
    callbacks.c
    win32k_thunks.c
    wow64win.c)

add_library(wow64win MODULE
    ${SOURCE}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wow64win_stubs.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wow64win.def)

set_module_type(wow64win win32dll ENTRYPOINT DllMain 12)
target_link_libraries(wow64win win32ksys pseh)
add_importlibs(wow64win wow64 ntdll)
add_dependencies(wow64win psdk)
add_cd_file(TARGET wow64win DESTINATION reactos/system32 FOR all)
